description:
Perform a stratified Mantel-Haenszel analysis to assess confounding using Epi Info 7. 

Starting from the 'Classic Analysis' module, you must:
1. Open the project/dataset located at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiInfoProjects\LowBirthWeight\lowbwt.csv' (or read the file directly).
2. Calculate the Crude Odds Ratio between Smoking (SMOKE) and Low Birth Weight (LOW).
3. Calculate the Adjusted Odds Ratio controlling for Race (RACE) using stratification.
4. Save the full analysis output to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiInfoProjects\LowBirthWeight\analysis_output.html'.
5. Create a summary report at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiInfoProjects\LowBirthWeight\confounding_report.txt' stating the Crude OR, Adjusted OR, and your conclusion on whether confounding is present (Change > 10%).
